title: Fixed-coefficient raw evaluation commutes with pullback
statement: Let B,T,Y,Yprime be schemes, a:Yprime→Y, h:Y→B, hprime:Yprime→B with a≫h=hprime, g:Y→T and gprime:Yprime→T with gprime=a≫g. Let K be a bounded-below derived abelian etale sheaf on T, q any integer, U etale over B, and z:Z[h*U][0]→g*K[q]. Pullback of [def-sc-raw-fixed-derived-comparison](z) along the canonical map U×_B Yprime→U×_B Y equals [def-sc-raw-fixed-derived-comparison] applied to rawRestrictedDerivedPullback(z), with coefficient morphism the inverse of the specified comparison gprime*K≅a*g*K. The cohomology pullback is presentationDerivedMap from [lem-weil-pbc-etale-complex-pullback-transport].

proof.text: Lift upperStarComp_assoc to derived categories using the proved generic mapDerivedCategoryNatIso whiskering and composition coherence lemmas. Cancel the two composition isomorphisms to obtain the coefficient comparison square.

Expand the canonical restricted derived section pullback and its shift comparison. The proved restrictedSectionPullback_commShift and transport_homology identity identify its shifted zeroth-homology conjugate with homology in degree q of the unshifted pullback.

Expand presentationDerivedMap into the derived-section pullback followed by inverse-image composition. Move the coefficient comparison through this natural transformation and use the coefficient square. The bounded-below inclusion sends upperStarCompDerivedPlus.inv to the same derived comparison.

Apply the existing proved rawRestrictedDerivedComparison_pullback to z with the inverse coefficient-composition morphism. Substitute the preceding cohomology-square identity; this gives the asserted equality of elements.

lean.statement:
theorem rawFixedDerivedComparison_naturality {B T Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ B) (h' : Y' ⟶ B) (w : a ≫ h = h')
    (g : Y ⟶ T) (g' : Y' ⟶ T) (wg : g' = a ≫ g)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (q : ℤ) (U : B.Etale)
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (((h)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj ((abelianComparisonFree B).obj U)) ⟶
      ((D+((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)⟦q⟧) :
    presentationDerivedMap (rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U)
        (pullback.snd U.hom h ≫ g) (pullback.snd U.hom h' ≫ g')
        (by simp [rawAffineRestrictedMap, wg, Category.assoc]) K.obj q
        (rawFixedDerivedComparison h g K q U z) =
      rawFixedDerivedComparison h' g' K q U
        (rawRestrictedDerivedPullback a h h' w _ _
          ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} a g g' wg).inv.app K)
          q U z)
